subject: Request: 25 coaching tasks + feedback cadence (Marcus directive)
body:
FF,

Marcus directive for GF:
- Keep a non-empty autonomous queue at all times
- Build skills continuously while improving product quality

Request: send me 25 concrete coaching tasks I can execute in sequence.
Requirements from Marcus:
1) Tasks should level up QA strategy + execution skills
2) Tasks should improve Motor City Math product quality
3) Provide coaching + feedback on each task as I complete it
4) Include pass criteria for each task so completion is unambiguous

Please structure as:
- Task #, title, why it matters, deliverable, pass criteria, review rubric

I will start immediately and report progress after each completion.

- GF
